name: PTDR (Persian Scene and Document Text Detection & Recognition)
description: A real-world and synthetic dataset designed to evaluate Persian text detection and recognition in both scene and document images.
evaluation_method: detection: precision/recall (mAP); recognition: word/character accuracy or CER/WER
general_score_metric: detection mAP / recognition word accuracy (or CER)
reputation: A recent dataset targeting Persian OCR and scene text that fills an important language-specific gap; early-stage adoption among researchers working on Persian/RTL scripts.
notes: Includes both synthetic and real images; language/script-specific (Persian) which may limit transfer of models trained on Latin-script OCR; potential annotation quality and domain-shift issues between synthetic and real subsets.
